sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 hybrid: a synced object routes to the AD leg
sys_atf_test.description: onPremisesSyncEnabled=true classifies as AD-mastered and the AD-leg dispatches the disable. It does NOT assert post-state on the dispatch return (P0-4: write methods carry no field resembling an observation) -- post-state comes only from a genuine read-back (getUserAd/isGroupMemberAd), which requires live AD and is out of scope for test_mode.

sys_atf_step.description: Assert the router predicate + the AD-leg dispatch contract for a synced object.
